```{r find non numeric unis}
#make a helper function to identify non-numeric grades for different unis

has_nonnumeric <- function(uni) {
  grades <- smarvus_filtered %>%
    filter(survey_id == uni) %>%
    pull(grade)
  
    any(is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(grades))))       
}

unis <- unique(smarvus_grades_only$survey_id)

nonnumeric_unis <- unis[sapply(unis, has_nonnumeric)]
nonnumeric_unis
```

```{r}
smarvus_grades_only %>%
  filter(survey_id == "york_can") %>%
  distinct(grade)
```
```{r}
#remove non-numeric and one 0-5 scale
#remove grades with %, comma instead of point, covert to numeric
smarvus_cont <- smarvus_filtered %>%
  filter(!survey_id %in% c("brawijaya", "limerick" ,"york_can", "vienna", "hungary")) %>%
  mutate(grade = str_remove_all(grade, "%") %>%
                   str_replace(",", ".") %>%
                   as.numeric()) 


cor_results_cont <- smarvus_cont %>%
  group_by(survey_id) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            r = cor(grade, stars_score, method = "spearman"))

```
